and_ - _(b) Pass any other order or order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case._ # 12. The Petitions were taken up by the Commission, in view of the urgency indicated _“Petitioners, i.e., Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL) and Sarjan Realities Private Limited (SRPL) submitted that the present Petitions have been filed with a prayer to set aside letter dated 1.9.2025 issued by the Respondent, CTUIL, by way of which, the connectivity of the said Petitioners was revoked in terms of Regulation 11B(2) of the CERC (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2024 (‘GNA Regulations’). The said revocation was on account of the fact that the Petitioners did not achieve the Financial Closure within the stipulated timeframe as prescribed under Regulation 11A(2) of the GNA Regulations. Accordingly, the Petitioners have also filed the Interlocutory Applications in their respective Petitions seeking immediate interim relief. Learned Counsel for the Petitioners further submitted as under:_ - _(j) As such, an interim relief needs to be granted so that the revocation of connectivity of the Petitioners is kept in abeyance and not to take any coercive or precipitative action pursuant to it, including the allotment of said connectivity to any third parties._ - _(b) The Respondent, CTUIL to file its reply/ submissions within three weeks after perusing the Financial Closure documents submitted by the Petitioners and serve a copy to the Petitioners. The Petitioners will file their rejoinder(s), if any, within two weeks thereafter._ - _(c) The Commission further directed that, in the interim, the revocation of connectivity of the Petitioners shall be kept in abeyance and further directed CTUIL not to take any coercive or precipitative actions against the Petitioners, including the allotment of said connectivity to any third parties pursuant to its letter dated 1.9.2025, till the next date of hearing.”_ - 17.Considering the submissions of the Parties, the Commission permitted the Respondent, CTUIL, to file its brief note of submissions/ written submissions, and the interim direction vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 02.09.2025 will continue till the final outcome of the Petitions. Subject to the above, the Commission reserved the matters for order. 27. We have considered the submissions of Petitioners and the information on record. As per the submission of the Petitioners, they have achieved the financial closure within the stipulated time i.e. on 21.06.2025 against the last date of 25.06.2025 in case of 768/MP/2025 and on 23.06.2025 against the last date of 26.06.2025 in case of 769/MP/2025, but have failed in timely submission of documents and submitted it after delay of 54 and 56 days respectively. _The Central Commission, for reasons to be recorded in writing, may relax any of the provisions of these regulations on its own motion or on an application made before it by an affected party to remove the hardship arising out of the operation of these regulations._ 32. Accordingly, we condone the delay in furnishing proof/ copy of financial closure documents in terms of the first proviso to Regulation 11A(2) of the GNA 2nd Amendment Regulations 2024 by the petitioners, subject to payment of compensation equivalent to 5% of the total Conn BGs amount submitted by the petitioners within 15 days of this Order. The amount received by the CTUIL under the aforementioned compensation shall be utilised to reduce the monthly transmission charges under the 2020 Sharing Regulations. On receipt of the compensation amount from the petitioners, CTUIL is directed to reinstate/ restore the connectivity of the Petitioners. However, this order shall not be treated as a precedent, having been decided keeping in view the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case.
title: Petition under Section 79 of the Electricity Act 2003 read with Regulations 11A, 41 and 42 of the CERC (General Network Access) Regulations 2022 (and its subsequent amendments), inter-alia seeking for quashing/ setting aside of the letter dated 01.09.2025 issued by the Central Transmission Utility of India Limited (CTUIL) thereby revoking the connectivity of 1050 MW of the Petitioner under Regulation 11B(2) of the CERC (General Network Access) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2024, amongst other relief(s). Adani Green Energy Limited, Sarjan Realities Private Limited
